author: (Ev. Marcus & Er. Marcus, 1963)

note.en: A tiny, almost shell-less sea slug, probably only a few millimetres long, known here from one specimen taken in 2001 about 1 km north-west of Manzanillo. No size was found, so the size shown is a rough estimate.
note.es: Una babosa de mar diminuta, casi sin concha, probablemente de pocos milímetros, conocida aquí por un ejemplar tomado en 2001 a cerca de 1 km al noroeste de Manzanillo. No se halló su talla, así que la talla indicada es una estimación aproximada.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
